meta.name: BAUER GROUP Division Lockups
meta.description: Single source of truth for the two-line division lockups. Add a division below and run `npm run generate:lockups`. Geometry is expressed as ratios of X (the height of the 'B' inside the Bildmarke) so every value survives scaling. Generated artifacts must never be hand-edited.

font.note: Build-time only. The generated SVGs contain outlined paths and no font data, so distributing them is not a font redistribution.
